parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description: This parameter is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch renew-instance --instance-id es-cn-n6w1o1x0w001c0000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3500000 --biz-body example-string --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
